footer.about: Greenway Exteriors is a locally owned exterior remodeling company in Wichita, serving homeowners since 2012. We replace windows and siding and handle doors, gutters, trim and paint.

A straight price for what the job needs
Windows and siding from one crew

All 87 of your Google reviews are five stars, and your customers say why in their own words: "no high pressure sales", "about half the price of the bigger companies you see all over media", and a crew that "didn't waste any daylight."

Your site has a page for every service and loads fast. But on a phone, the first screen hides what you do and your number, and two claims don't match BBB. So we rebuilt it around what your customers praise.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how the demo fixes it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: On a phone, the top of your homepage is a financing bar, your logo and a photo. Your headline and number sit a full screen down, out of sight.
The headline names two services, not the kind of company you are, so Google can't match you to "exterior remodeling company Wichita".
It says "over 15 years", your siding page says "since 2012", and BBB shows 14. A homeowner who spots that doubts the rest.
fixes: Your headline and your number, one tap, at the very top.
A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows and doors are about 44% of your written reviews.
problems: The "CALL" line at the top is plain text, so a phone visitor has to type your number by hand.
The page claims "BBB accreditation", but BBB lists you as not accredited, and a careful buyer can check that in a minute.
fixes: Your number, one tap, at the top of the page.
Only claims a homeowner can check.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Siding Replacement
cards.why: Siding and trim are about 45% of your written reviews.
problems: Your menu lists nine siding pages by material, and none says you'll do one wall or a chimney, jobs your reviews say others turned down.
"Gutters" in your menu opens the homepage instead of a page.
fixes: One siding replacement page for a full re-side or a single wall, garage or chimney.
A menu where every link opens the page it names.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where interest turns into a call.
problems: Your hours read "Monday-Sunday, 24 Hours", which sounds like a template, not a local crew.
fixes: Your number and address together, with what to have ready.
No hours claim until you give us your real ones.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already call you honest, fair and fast. Book a strategy call with Fluid Frame and we'll walk you through this demo, confirm every service and detail, and show you what a full build adds.

onboardingQuestions: John Dye is confirmed as owner (BBB, About page, reviews). Who is Michelle (thanked in one review), and should she be named?
Phone: (316) 641-8365 matches Google and the site. BBB lists (316) 453-6043 and a directory lists (316) 816-9395; confirm both are old.
Email: the site shows greenwayvalue@gmail.com on every page, but it is not in our fact sheet. Is it the address to show?
Address: 2807 W River Park Dr, Wichita 67203 is on Google and the site. Is it a shop customers can visit, or an office only?
Real hours: the site says "Monday-Sunday, 24 Hours", which reads like template text. No hours are shown in the package.
Years: BBB shows a start of 8/28/2012 (14 years) while the site says both "since 2012" and "over 15 years". Confirm 2012.

BBB: the site claims accreditation but BBB lists the business as not accredited (A+ rating, no complaints). Do they want to apply for accreditation, or just have the claim removed? The package shows no BBB claim.
Licensing and insurance: the site says "fully licensed and insured Kansas contractor", but no license number or registry record was found. Provide the number to show.

Brands: ProVia (three customers name it) and James Hardie (the site claims Preferred Installer) could not be verified on the manufacturers' locators. Which brands do they install and may we name them? Also LP SmartSide, and Chamber of Commerce membership and awards ("Best of Business Award", "Mark of Excellence").
Warranty: what do the window and siding warranties cover and for how long? Review mentions of a warranty give no terms, so the package only says to ask John.
Financing: which lender, what are the current terms, and does "No Payments Until 2027 + 0% for 18 Months" end soon? The package says only "available, subject to credit approval".

Full list of services: confirm doors (sliding glass, entry), egress and basement windows, gutters and gutter protection, exterior painting, chimney siding and deck frame repair. Is there any roofing? Do they want door and gutter pages later?
Typical install times for windows and siding, so the schedule lines can be firmed up.
Towns: confirm the 15-town list from their homepage, and that Augusta (named in one review) is in range.
Do they want the 25 Wichita attraction pages on their current site kept? They are unrelated to the work.
Logo file and brand colors (not sampled; the logo is green and gray on their site).
